starting_balance = 88599

# Subtract 94 refunds of 17597

balance -= refunds

# Add 67 deposits of 17224
deposits = 67 * 17224
balance += deposits
print(f"After adding 67 deposits of 17224 ({deposits}): {balance}")

print(f"\nFinal balance: {balance}")
EOF
